svg.title: For the remaining component the chart’s support forces t ≤s; use the full finite projection remain- der estimate through Li−1, giving Gv = Li. If Li = 0, there is no projection and the same estimate is the coarsening inequality with zero gain. For a projected component, the degree-h readout esti- mate supplies Gv = h. The common detector collar justifies these operations on the actual moving palettes. The new scalar price is exactly B′ w = Bw(a/Ri)Gv.
